name: P.A.G.E
source:
This is a short romantic narrative about a young woman on vacation. She's single and exploring a new country, and a generally hopeless lesbian adrift in the world.

She stumbles across a small cozy bookstore while out and about, and encounters a few gorgeous women that enrapture her on sight.

[From [url=https://cmlgames.itch.io/page]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于一位年轻女子度假的简短浪漫故事。她是单身，正在探索一个新的国家，也是一个在世界上漂泊的绝望女同性恋。

她在外出时偶然发现了一家舒适的小书店，并遇到了几位让她一见倾心的漂亮女人。

[来自[url=https://cmlgames.itch.io/page]itch.io[/url]]
